scope: New public-deck-based coupon FEM13 conditions: train5/validation4/test4, 919 identical nodes, 10 saved nonzero times, 7 physical channels. Small fixed-geometry interpolation; not appliance drop validation.
counting: Six trained static configurations: Transolver, FLARE, GeoTransolver GALE, GeoTransolver GALE_FA, MeshGraphNet, FIGConvUNet. GALE_FA is a genuine GeoTransolver backend variant, not an independent named class. Temporal and ROM experiments are separate artifacts.
policy: Frozen common data and training-only vector/scalar normalization. Equal normalized node/time/channel loss. Minimum100, validation-patience100, maximum1000 epochs. No test-driven tuning, no clipping. Reaching the epoch cap is not convergence proof.
comparison_limitations: One seed and small per-architecture configurations; differing parameter counts, optimizer-update counts after early stopping and execution costs. These measurements do not establish a universal algorithm ranking. Saved-frame maxima are not continuous-time peaks.

normalization_groups.definition: sqrt(trace(training displacement covariance)/3), shared by all three vector components

epsp_support_and_history_diagnostics.support_definition: Reference EPSP >0 exactly; prediction >0 exactly. No clipping/threshold tuning. This is a nodal averaged projected support, not a raw-cell damage criterion.

history_diagnostics.definition: Exact negative time increments at fixed projected support; raw cumulative EPSP is expected not to decrease. Report reference rounding/decrease separately; no correction is applied.
history_diagnostics.interpretation: Strict negative counts include roundoff-sized changes. Quantile magnitudes and the same truth statistics are reported without an invented pass/fail threshold.

principal_order_diagnostics.definition: A projected in-plane major principal strain must be >= its paired minor principal strain. No reordering is applied.
